column1: # Manifest: per-biosample ENCODE Registry V4 cCRE files -> biosample
# RESTORED 30 July 2026 from the copy saved at chr12q/manifest.tsv, which disappeared
# from disk (OneDrive sync) shortly after being written. Content is as filled in;
# please spot-check before relying on it.
# WHAT IS PREFILLED (verified from the file contents):
#   classification  - FULL      = DNase + H3K4me3 + H3K27ac + CTCF assayed (col 11
#                                 can ONLY return Low-DNase or CA-only
#                     CHIP_ONLY = one or two ChIP marks assayed with NO DNase (col 11 is still
#                                 files cannot call Low-DNase/CA-only either). Elements carry raw
#                                 signal labels instead of standard cCRE classes (e.g. High-H3K4me3,
#   lookup          - the exact ENCODE page for the first accession in the filename
#   biosample_group - ENCODE labels collapsed into biosample categories. 'liver tissue',
#                     'right lobe of liver' and 'left lobe of liver' are all bulk liver and
#                       liver_tissue           whole liver, any lobe            (13 files)
#                     Reporting by this column avoids implying 18 independent biosample
#                     types when several files share a label.
# VALIDATED against the file contents on 30 July 2026: all 18 files present and unique,
# classification matches the data in every case (3 FULL / 10 PARTIAL / 5 CHIP_ONLY), and
# all group values fall within {primary, cell_line, in_vitro_differentiated}.
#   primary                  liver tissue, liver lobe, hepatocyte, other primary liver cells
#   cell_line                HepG2, HuH-7, Hep3B and other hepatoma/hepatoblastoma lines
